title: Gateway File Reorganization — Split gateway_handlers.go
description: Split the monolithic gateway_handlers.go (100KB, 3200 lines, 45+ handlers) into domain-specific handler files. The original gateway.go→4 file split was good but gateway_handlers.go consolidated too many domains. Split into: gateway_jobs.go (jobs, memory, artifacts, traces), gateway_workflows.go (workflows, runs), gateway_config.go (config, schemas), gateway_dlq.go (DLQ), gateway_locks.go (locks), gateway_approvals.go (approvals), gateway_policy_eval.go (policy eval/simulate/explain). Target 200-500 lines per file. Test files stay alongside source files per Go convention (they use package gateway and reference 50+ unexported symbols).
architectureNotes: All files remain in package gateway. No logic changes — pure file moves. Each new file gets the handler functions for its domain plus any tightly-coupled private helpers/types only used by those handlers. Route registration stays in gateway_core.go. Shared helpers stay in gateway_helpers.go. gRPC methods (SubmitJob, GetJobStatus) go into a new gateway_grpc.go. After the split, gateway_handlers.go should be deleted (empty). Test files are NOT moved — they reference unexported symbols heavily.
epicRails: Pure file reorganization — no logic changes, no renaming, no refactoring
All files stay in package gateway
Route registration stays in gateway_core.go — only handler function definitions move
Test files remain alongside source files (Go convention, unexported symbol access)
go build ./cmd/cordum-api-gateway must pass after each task
